Add fitted values and residuals to the data

Source: R/augment.R
augment.kb_fit.Rd

Append the fitted() and deviance residuals() values to the input data.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
augment(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

Value

The input data with added columns fitted (the posterior median of the expected response) and residual (the posterior median of the deviance residual).

See also

fitted() and residuals().

Other fit methods: coef.kb_fit(), fitted.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_samples(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), residuals.kb_fit(), summary.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

Examples

augment(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
